summary_en: 250,000 shares (2.43% of S/O) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-19 at opening session; upper limit ¥765.0M at closing price of ¥3,060/share. Order limited to specified trading session; partial or full non-execution possible.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury shares and purchase of treasury shares via off-market purchase (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 2026-08-18, IWATSUKA CONFECTIONERY's board authorized acquisition of up to 250,000 treasury shares via ToSTNeT-3 off-market purchase on 2026-08-19 at the 08:45 morning opening session. The upper limit is ¥765.0M based on the prior day's closing price of ¥3,060/share. The 250,000-share ceiling represents 2.43% of shares outstanding (computed as 250,000 ÷ 10,299,487 ex-treasury shares). The purchase order is limited to that single trading session; partial execution or non-execution is possible due to market conditions. The acquisition is undertaken to pursue flexible capital allocation in response to changing business circumstances. Results will be published immediately after the trading session closes.
